items.title: Protesters clash with police ahead of G7 summit in Geneva
items.description: Swiss police deployed a water cannon and fired tear gas to disperse anti-G7 protesters after clashes.

items.title: Police fire tear gas at anti-G7 protesters in Geneva
items.description: Protesters in Geneva clashed with police, set a car on fire and smashed the windows of a bank to show their opposition to the G7 summit taking place across the border in France.

items.title: Italy: Thousands attend anti- and pro-migration rallies in Rome
items.description: Tens of thousands of people demonstrated in the Italian capital for rival protests. The rallies took place after a proposed bill seeking measures against migrants secured enough support to be brought before parliament.
